_comment: Curated naming table for gen_java.py. Keys of `endpoints` are 'METHOD /path-template' exactly as they appear in spec.json after example-path hygiene. `title` records the upstream Chinese title the method name was derived from. request/response may name a generated DTO, an existing shared model, 'void', or '[]Type' for a top-level array; a dotted name is used as a fully qualified type.

Alignment.doc: Rich text paragraph alignment values (docs type Alignment); the wire carries the raw int.

AtType.doc: Elements that can be mentioned with At (docs type AtType); the wire carries the raw int.

AuditType.doc: Forum audit result types (docs type AuditType); the wire carries the raw int.

ChannelSubType.doc: Sub-channel sub types (docs type ChannelSubType); the wire carries the raw int.

ChannelType.doc: Sub-channel types (docs type ChannelType); the wire carries the raw int.

DefaultRoleIDsID.doc: Default guild role ids (docs type DefaultRoleIDsID); the wire carries the raw id as a string.

ElemType.doc: Rich text element types (docs type ElemType); the wire carries the raw int.

EmojiType.doc: Reaction emoji types (docs type EmojiType); the wire carries the raw int.

Format.doc: Forum thread content formats (docs type Format); the wire carries the raw int.

Permissions.doc: Sub-channel permission bit map (docs type Permissions); the wire carries a decimal string of the bit map.

PrivateType.doc: Visibility of a private sub-channel (docs type PrivateType); the wire carries the raw int.

ReactionTargetType.doc: Targets a reaction can be attached to (docs type ReactionTargetType); the wire carries the raw int.

RemindType.doc: Schedule reminder offsets (docs type RemindType); the wire carries the raw id as a string.

RichType.doc: Rich text element payloads (docs type RichType); the wire carries the raw int.

SpeakPermission.doc: Who may speak in a sub-channel (docs type SpeakPermission); the wire carries the raw int.

STATUS.doc: Audio playback states for the sub-channel bot (docs type STATUS); the wire carries the raw int.

GET /users/@me.title: 获取机器人详情
GET /users/@me.doc: Fetch the bot's own profile, including the union ids and the group share link.

GET /users/@me/guilds.title: 获取机器人频道列表
GET /users/@me/guilds.doc: List the guilds the bot has joined; page with before/after ids and a limit of 1-100.

POST /users/@me/dms.title: 创建私信会话
POST /users/@me/dms.doc: Open (or reuse) a private chat session with a user in a guild before sending direct messages.

POST /v2/generate_url_link.title: 生成分享链接
POST /v2/generate_url_link.doc: Generate the bot's group share link, optionally echoing callback_data back to the visitor.

GET /gateway.title: 获取 WebSocket 路径
GET /gateway.doc: Fetch the WebSocket endpoint the bot should connect to.

GET /gateway/bot.title: 带 Shard 的 WebSocket 路径
GET /gateway/bot.doc: Fetch the WebSocket endpoint plus the recommended shard count and the session start quota.

PUT /interactions/{interaction_id}.title: 互动事件响应
PUT /interactions/{interaction_id}.doc: Acknowledge an INTERACTION_CREATE event; only button (type 11) and shortcut menu (type 12) interactions need it, and each interaction_id can be answered once before it expires.

GET /v2/menu.title: 查询全局自定义菜单
GET /v2/menu.doc: Fetch the bot's global custom menu together with its version.

PUT /v2/menu.title: 修改全局自定义菜单
PUT /v2/menu.doc: Replace the whole global custom menu; the returned version increments on success.

GET /v2/panels.title: 查询指令面板列表
GET /v2/panels.doc: List command panels for a scope (c2c, group, channel or dm), paginated with cursor and limit.

POST /v2/panels.title: 创建指令面板
POST /v2/panels.doc: Create a command panel and bind it to all users or to the listed user/group openids.

GET /v2/panels/{panel_id}.title: 查询指令面板详情
GET /v2/panels/{panel_id}.doc: Fetch one command panel with its items and its bound users and groups.

PUT /v2/panels/{panel_id}.title: 修改指令面板
PUT /v2/panels/{panel_id}.doc: Replace the items of a command panel; the returned version is the new panel version.

PUT /v2/panels/{panel_id}/target.title: 修改指令面板关联对象
PUT /v2/panels/{panel_id}/target.doc: Add or remove the users (c2c scope) or groups (group scope) a panel is bound to, at most 20 openids per call; channel and dm scopes are global and do not support this.

POST /v2/users/{user_openid}/messages.title: 发送单聊消息
POST /v2/users/{user_openid}/messages.doc: Send a C2C message; passive replies must carry msg_id (from C2C_MESSAGE_CREATE) or event_id, are limited to 4 answers per message and expire 5 minutes after the original event.

DELETE /v2/users/{user_openid}/messages/.title: 撤回单聊消息
DELETE /v2/users/{user_openid}/messages/.doc: Recall a C2C message the bot sent; messages older than 2 minutes cannot be recalled and the bot may only recall its own messages.

POST /v2/users/{user_openid}/stream_mess.title: 流式发送单聊消息
POST /v2/users/{user_openid}/stream_mess.doc: Push one chunk of a streamed C2C answer; keep stream_msg_id from the first response and increase index from 0, finishing with input_state 10.

POST /v2/users/{user_openid}/files.title: 单聊富媒体上传
POST /v2/users/{user_openid}/files.doc: Upload an image, video, voice or file to a C2C chat by url or by merging a chunked upload; the returned file_info feeds the media field of sendC2CMessage and is valid for ttl seconds.

POST /v2/users/{user_id}/upload_prepare.title: 单聊富媒体预上传
POST /v2/users/{user_id}/upload_prepare.doc: Start a chunked C2C upload and receive the upload_id, the presigned part urls and the upload configuration.

POST /v2/users/{user_id}/upload_part_fin.title: 单聊分片上传完成
POST /v2/users/{user_id}/upload_part_fin.doc: Report one finished chunk of a C2C upload; call uploadC2CMedia with the upload_id once every part is done.

POST /v2/groups/{group_openid}/messages.title: 发送群聊消息
POST /v2/groups/{group_openid}/messages.doc: Send a group message; passive replies must carry msg_id (from GROUP_AT_MESSAGE_CREATE or GROUP_MESSAGE_CREATE) or event_id, are limited to 5 answers within 5 minutes, and group messages do not support streaming fields.

DELETE /v2/groups/{group_openid}/message.title: 撤回群聊消息
DELETE /v2/groups/{group_openid}/message.doc: Recall a group message; messages older than 2 minutes cannot be recalled, and a bot that is not an administrator may only recall its own messages.

POST /v2/groups/{group_openid}/files.title: 群聊富媒体上传
POST /v2/groups/{group_openid}/files.doc: Upload an image, video, voice or file to a group by url or by merging a chunked upload; the returned file_info feeds the media field of sendGroupMessage and is valid for ttl seconds.

POST /v2/groups/{group_id}/upload_prepar.title: 群聊富媒体预上传
POST /v2/groups/{group_id}/upload_prepar.doc: Start a chunked group upload and receive the upload_id, the presigned part urls and the upload configuration.

POST /v2/groups/{group_id}/upload_part_f.title: 群聊分片上传完成
POST /v2/groups/{group_id}/upload_part_f.doc: Report one finished chunk of a group upload; call uploadGroupMedia with the upload_id once every part is done.

GET /v2/groups/{group_openid}/info.title: 获取群基本信息
GET /v2/groups/{group_openid}/info.doc: Fetch a group's name, memo, tags and member count.

GET /v2/groups/{group_openid}/bot_state.title: 获取机器人群内状态
GET /v2/groups/{group_openid}/bot_state.doc: Fetch the bot's own state inside a group, including whether proactive messages are allowed.

GET /v2/groups/{group_openid}/members.title: 获取群成员列表
GET /v2/groups/{group_openid}/members.doc: Page through a group's members with the cursor returned by the previous call.

GET /v2/groups/{group_openid}/members/{m.title: 获取群成员信息
GET /v2/groups/{group_openid}/members/{m.doc: Fetch one group member's profile and role.

POST /v2/groups/{group_openid}/batch_rem.title: 群成员批量移除
POST /v2/groups/{group_openid}/batch_rem.doc: Kick several members out of a group in one call; the bot must be the owner or an administrator.

GET /v2/groups/{group_openid}/member_bla.title: 群黑名单查询
GET /v2/groups/{group_openid}/member_bla.doc: Page through the members a group has blacklisted.

POST /v2/groups/{group_openid}/member_bl.title: 群黑名单操作
POST /v2/groups/{group_openid}/member_bl.doc: Add members to or remove them from the group blacklist, returning the openids the operation failed for.

GET /v2/groups/{group_openid}/join_reque.title: 入群申请列表拉取
GET /v2/groups/{group_openid}/join_reque.doc: Page through pending join requests of a group.

POST /v2/groups/{group_openid}/approval_.title: 入群申请审批
POST /v2/groups/{group_openid}/approval_.doc: Approve or decline a join request with op approve/decline; the bot must be a group administrator.

GET /v2/groups/{group_openid}/restrict_c.title: 查询群禁言状态
GET /v2/groups/{group_openid}/restrict_c.doc: Read the whole-group mute rule and the per-member mute list; the bot must be a group administrator.

POST /v2/groups/{group_openid}/restrict_.title: 设置群成员禁言
POST /v2/groups/{group_openid}/restrict_.doc: Mute, update or unmute group members, at most 20 per call and at most 30 days long; the bot must be a group administrator.

GET /v2/groups/join_approval_strategy.title: 查询入群自动审批策略列表
GET /v2/groups/join_approval_strategy.doc: Page through the automatic join approval strategies of the bot.

POST /v2/groups/join_approval_strategy.title: 创建入群自动审批策略
POST /v2/groups/join_approval_strategy.doc: Create an automatic join approval strategy for the given groups with an optional expiry.

PATCH /v2/groups/join_approval_strategy/.title: 修改入群自动审批策略
PATCH /v2/groups/join_approval_strategy/.doc: Enable or disable a strategy, move its expiry, or add and remove the groups it covers.

DELETE /v2/groups/join_approval_strategy.title: 删除入群自动审批策略
DELETE /v2/groups/join_approval_strategy.doc: Delete an automatic join approval strategy.

POST /v2/groups/join_approval_strategy/{.title: 执行入群自动审批策略
POST /v2/groups/join_approval_strategy/{.doc: Run an automatic join approval strategy against the pending join requests right now.

POST /v2/groups/join_approval_strategy/{.title: 修改入群自动审批策略的白名单号码
POST /v2/groups/join_approval_strategy/{.doc: Add or remove the QQ numbers exempt from an automatic join approval strategy.

GET /guilds/{guild_id}.title: 获取频道详情
GET /guilds/{guild_id}.doc: Fetch one guild the bot has joined.

GET /guilds/{guild_id}/members.title: 获取频道成员列表
GET /guilds/{guild_id}/members.doc: Page through a guild's members with the last member id of the previous page and a limit of 1-400.

GET /guilds/{guild_id}/members/{user_id}.title: 获取频道成员详情
GET /guilds/{guild_id}/members/{user_id}.doc: Fetch one guild member with the user profile, nickname and role ids.

DELETE /guilds/{guild_id}/members/{user_.title: 删除频道成员
DELETE /guilds/{guild_id}/members/{user_.doc: Kick a guild member, optionally blacklisting them and recalling their messages of the last N days.

PATCH /guilds/{guild_id}/members/{user_i.title: 修改频道成员禁言状态
PATCH /guilds/{guild_id}/members/{user_i.doc: Mute one guild member for a number of seconds or until an absolute timestamp; when both are sent the timestamp wins.

PATCH /guilds/{guild_id}/mute.title: 禁言整个频道
PATCH /guilds/{guild_id}/mute.doc: Mute a whole guild for a number of seconds or until an absolute timestamp; when both are sent the timestamp wins.

PATCH /guilds/{guild_id}/mute#user_ids.title: 频道批量成员禁言
PATCH /guilds/{guild_id}/mute#user_ids.doc: Mute a batch of guild members (non-admins); send mute_end_timestamp or mute_seconds, and the string "0" to lift the mute. At most 20 members per call and 30 days long.

GET /guilds/{guild_id}/message/setting.title: 获取频道发言设置
GET /guilds/{guild_id}/message/setting.doc: Read whether the bot may create direct messages and push messages, and the per-channel push quota.

GET /guilds/{guild_id}/api_permission.title: 获取接口权限
GET /guilds/{guild_id}/api_permission.doc: List the API permissions of a guild with the authorization status of each one.

POST /guilds/{guild_id}/api_permission/d.title: 创建接口权限需求
POST /guilds/{guild_id}/api_permission/d.doc: Send an authorization request link into a sub-channel so a guild administrator can grant the bot an API permission.

PATCH /channels/{channel_id}.title: 修改子频道
PATCH /channels/{channel_id}.doc: Rename, reorder, move or change the visibility and speak permission of a sub-channel.

GET /channels/{channel_id}/online_nums.title: 获取子频道在线成员数
GET /channels/{channel_id}/online_nums.doc: Fetch how many members are online in a voice sub-channel.

GET /guilds/{guild_id}/channels.title: 获取子频道列表
GET /guilds/{guild_id}/channels.doc: List the sub-channels of a guild.

POST /guilds/{guild_id}/channels.title: 创建子频道
POST /guilds/{guild_id}/channels.doc: Create a sub-channel in a guild; private channels must also list their members via private_user_ids.

POST /channels/{channel_id}/messages.title: 创建消息
POST /channels/{channel_id}/messages.doc: Send a message into a sub-channel; passive replies must carry msg_id or event_id and are only accepted for 5 minutes after the original event.

DELETE /channels/{channel_id}/messages/{.title: 删除消息
DELETE /channels/{channel_id}/messages/{.doc: Recall a sub-channel message, optionally hiding the grey hint line.

POST /dms/{guild_id}/messages.title: 创建私信消息
POST /dms/{guild_id}/messages.doc: Send a message into a direct message session created with createDirectMessageSession; passive replies must carry msg_id or event_id.

DELETE /dms/{guild_id}/messages/{message.title: 删除私信消息
DELETE /dms/{guild_id}/messages/{message.doc: Recall a message from a direct message session, optionally hiding the grey hint line.

PUT /channels/{channel_id}/messages/{mes.title: 发表消息表情表态
PUT /channels/{channel_id}/messages/{mes.doc: Add the bot's emoji reaction to a message; type follows EmojiType and id an entry of the emoji list.

DELETE /channels/{channel_id}/messages/{.title: 删除机器人发表的表情表态
DELETE /channels/{channel_id}/messages/{.doc: Remove the bot's own emoji reaction from a message.

GET /channels/{channel_id}/messages/{mes.title: 获取消息表情表态的用户列表
GET /channels/{channel_id}/messages/{mes.doc: List who reacted with a given emoji; limit applies to the first call only and later pages continue with the returned cookie.

GET /channels/{channel_id}/pins.title: 获取置顶消息
GET /channels/{channel_id}/pins.doc: List the pinned messages of a sub-channel.

PUT /channels/{channel_id}/pins/{message.title: 置顶消息
PUT /channels/{channel_id}/pins/{message.doc: Pin a message to the top of a sub-channel and return the new pin list.

DELETE /channels/{channel_id}/pins/{mess.title: 取消置顶消息
DELETE /channels/{channel_id}/pins/{mess.doc: Remove a message pin from a sub-channel.

GET /channels/{channel_id}/schedules.title: 获取日程列表
GET /channels/{channel_id}/schedules.doc: List the schedules of a sub-channel from a start timestamp onwards.

GET /channels/{channel_id}/schedules/{sc.title: 获取日程详情
GET /channels/{channel_id}/schedules/{sc.doc: Fetch one schedule of a sub-channel.

POST /channels/{channel_id}/schedules.title: 创建日程
POST /channels/{channel_id}/schedules.doc: Create a schedule in a sub-channel; the id inside the schedule object is ignored.

PATCH /channels/{channel_id}/schedules/{.title: 修改日程
PATCH /channels/{channel_id}/schedules/{.doc: Replace a schedule in a sub-channel; the schedule object must not carry an id.

DELETE /channels/{channel_id}/schedules/.title: 删除日程
DELETE /channels/{channel_id}/schedules/.doc: Delete a schedule from a sub-channel.

GET /channels/{channel_id}/threads.title: 获取帖子列表
GET /channels/{channel_id}/threads.doc: Page through the threads of a forum sub-channel until is_finish is set.

GET /channels/{channel_id}/threads/{thre.title: 获取帖子详情
GET /channels/{channel_id}/threads/{thre.doc: Fetch one thread of a forum sub-channel.

PUT /channels/{channel_id}/threads.title: 发帖
PUT /channels/{channel_id}/threads.doc: Publish a thread into a forum sub-channel; the content format follows Format and the result is audited asynchronously.

DELETE /channels/{channel_id}/threads/{t.title: 删除帖子
DELETE /channels/{channel_id}/threads/{t.doc: Delete a thread from a forum sub-channel.

POST /channels/{channel_id}/audio.title: 发布控制台
POST /channels/{channel_id}/audio.doc: Drive the voice bot of a sub-channel: play a url, pause, resume or stop, with optional text-to-speech.

PUT /channels/{channel_id}/mic.title: 机器人上麦
PUT /channels/{channel_id}/mic.doc: Make the bot join the microphone of a voice sub-channel.

DELETE /channels/{channel_id}/mic.title: 机器人下麦
DELETE /channels/{channel_id}/mic.doc: Make the bot leave the microphone of a voice sub-channel.

POST /guilds/{guild_id}/announces.title: 创建成员公告
POST /guilds/{guild_id}/announces.doc: Publish a message as guild announce or welcome announce, or replace the recommended channel list in one call.

GET /guilds/{guild_id}/roles.title: 获取频道身份组列表
GET /guilds/{guild_id}/roles.doc: List the roles of a guild together with the role quota.

POST /guilds/{guild_id}/roles.title: 创建频道身份组
POST /guilds/{guild_id}/roles.doc: Create a role in a guild; color is the decimal value of the ARGB hex colour.

PATCH /guilds/{guild_id}/roles/{role_id}.title: 修改频道身份组
PATCH /guilds/{guild_id}/roles/{role_id}.doc: Rename a role or change its colour and whether it is shown separately.

DELETE /guilds/{guild_id}/roles/{role_id.title: 删除频道身份组
DELETE /guilds/{guild_id}/roles/{role_id.doc: Delete a role from a guild.

GET /guilds/{guild_id}/roles/{role_id}/m.title: 获取身份组成员列表
GET /guilds/{guild_id}/roles/{role_id}/m.doc: Page through the members holding a role with start_index and a limit of 1-400.

PUT /guilds/{guild_id}/members/{user_id}.title: 给频道成员添加身份组
PUT /guilds/{guild_id}/members/{user_id}.doc: Grant a role to a guild member; pass a channel object with only the id filled to scope the role to a sub-channel.

DELETE /guilds/{guild_id}/members/{user_.title: 删除频道成员身份组
DELETE /guilds/{guild_id}/members/{user_.doc: Revoke a role from a guild member; pass a channel object with only the id filled to scope the role to a sub-channel.

GET /channels/{channel_id}/members/{user.title: 获取子频道成员权限
GET /channels/{channel_id}/members/{user.doc: Read the permission bit map a member holds in a sub-channel.

PUT /channels/{channel_id}/members/{user.title: 修改子频道成员权限
PUT /channels/{channel_id}/members/{user.doc: Grant and revoke sub-channel permissions for one member with decimal bit map strings.

GET /channels/{channel_id}/roles/{role_i.title: 获取子频道身份组权限
GET /channels/{channel_id}/roles/{role_i.doc: Read the permission bit map a role holds in a sub-channel.

PUT /channels/{channel_id}/roles/{role_i.title: 修改子频道身份组权限
PUT /channels/{channel_id}/roles/{role_i.doc: Grant and revoke sub-channel permissions for one role with decimal bit map strings.
